sample_unit: suspicious pigmented lesions (histopathology-confirmed MM n=15, benign n=33) from 423 participants
models_evaluated: commercially available AI-embedded dermoscopy software for melanoma predictive scoring

links.outcome: AI melanoma detection performance on local clinical population against histopathology
links.effect: Sensitivity 53.33%, specificity 54.44%, accuracy 54.17% in this clinical population, lower than expected from prior published performance.
links.quote: The performance of the AI from this clinical population was found to have a sensitivity of 53.33%, specificity of 54.44% and accuracy of 54.17%.

screen.reason: The study evaluates the performance of a commercial AI diagnostic tool during clinical skin cancer screening of outdoor enthusiasts, but evaluates diagnostic accuracy without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
